data.title: 2houses: Better Co-parenting
data.description:
Are you a separated parent? 

2houses is the ideal co parenting app, for all types of separated parents (with one child or more).

2houses is a set of tools that helps separated parents to communicate and become better organized for the well-being of their children. 2houses removes the emotional stress in the family.

What does 2houses propose to simplify your co parenting life?

CALENDAR: 2houses offers an interactive shared calendar with many opportunities for sharing and synchronization, which is needed for a modern family. We have also set up specific features for separated parents who can, through our interface, set a co-parenting app calendar and manage changes without any time clashes. Becoming organized in a simple way is no longer impossible for a separated family.

FINANCE: We offer a simple and effective financial management system for parents. For example, you can view reports by specific categories or periods. What other features does it have? For separated parents, 2houses manages shared expenses and continuously displays the balance to ensure equilibrated and healthy accounts.

MESSAGES: 2houses offers a simple messaging tool that is efficient and secure. Keep track of all your communications, whether with the other parent, with one of your children, or even with your mediator. You can archive your conversations or print them out, but under no circumstances can they be deleted!

INFO BANK: Are you looking for the tennis coach's contact details? Need the doctor? Stop looking everywhere for your child's information!
You will certainly find all of this in the information bank: Clothing sizes, Social Security numbers, school documents... 

JOURNAL: The journal is your quick family social network. You can share all information, news, photos, videos, and even your children’s funny quotes in a simple way. The family is never far away, no matter where you are.

ALBUMS: The photo album gives you the opportunity to share or download optimal resolution photos in a closed and secured environment. Even more memories to watch without moderation.

NOTIFICATIONS: Stay informed about your 2houses account’s activities via email and push notifications. Configure, at your leisure, the type of notification with the type of activity and do not miss a single thing.

PRIVACY & SECURITY: The information provided by you is used only to supply your account and is not used for any other purpose.
Information about children is added to the account by you without any obligation.
Your account is protected by an encrypted password that only you know. Each parent has their own access protected by a login and password. The private information of each parent (email address, credit card, phone number, etc.) is not accessible by the other.

SUBSCRIPTION TERMS

You need to subscribe to a paid plan to access all features after your 14-day free trial. Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase.
Your subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
Your 2houses subscription can be managed and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your Apple Account Settings after purchase.
Any unused portion of the free trial period, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription to that publication.

They talk about us:

● “I advise all my clients to use your app.” Michel Rosten - Parenting coordinator
● “It allows to change the thinking and unlock crisis.” Alice Coopter - Mediator
● "The 2houses co-parenting website makes single parenting easier." Yahoo Shine
● "Split families will avoid a lot of personal tension, stress, and discussions." Techcrunch

Contact us at contact@2houses.com with any questions or comments; 2houses would love to make your co parenting life simple !

2houses Terms of Service: https://www.2houses.com/en/terms-of-use/

data.release_notes:
Our teams are working relentlessly to prioritize and integrate user feedback, to ensure a positive and impactful experience for co-parents around the world.
With every new version, 2houses is getting better at supporting co-parenting needs related to shared calendars, expense management, custody journal, secure communication.
